rca_of_issue:
TTS Web Platform Issue RCA:
- Root Cause: expo-file-system's FileSystem.EncodingType.Base64 is not available on web platform, only on native iOS/Android
- Impact: Auto-speak feature throws error when trying to write base64 audio to file system on web
- Reproduction: Enable auto-speak toggle, send chat message, AI response triggers TTS which fails
- Mitigation: Add platform detection using Platform.OS. For web, convert base64 audio to blob and use HTML Audio element. For native, keep current FileSystem approach.
- Code location: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx lines 283-302 in speakText function
